units.rawText: Hi, Professor... Hehehe, you've got great timing. I've prepared a place for you.

units.rawText: The infinite darkness is steeped in loneliness, silence, and helplessness... Every star has lost its shine, drawn slowly into the all-consuming void...

units.rawText: But one day, a special celestial body appears within the darkness... bringing light, heat, and... gravity.

units.rawText: Countless stars begin to shine, as if they're orbiting around me and Hubble, leaving luminous trails across the planetarium.

units.rawText: ...This story... Heh, so this is the brand new projector you were doing research on.

units.rawText: With help from the medical department and the Jiutian Sector, I finally completed it, though it took some time. It's like a zero-gravity chamber created by humans, but with added healing effects.
